title: Direct Employer Route Discovery Before Apply
literal_acceptance: Before an automatic submission through an aggregator: attempt lightweight resolution of whether that listing ultimately routes to the employer ATS. Do not delay indefinitely.

independent_review.scope: Read-only source and regression review; not runtime or full acceptance evidence
findings_fixed: Integrated boards and UNKNOWN/mislabeled provider URLs could bypass the initial probe rule; exemptions now require the actual URL and current verified destination evidence
Inherited PostgreSQL consent insertion relied on rowcount and could persist consumption while denying admission; RETURNING identifies the atomic result

native_history.detail: Initial supporting resolver module path incorrectly used tests/integration; no tests executed. Correct path is tests/unit/test_direct_employer_route_redirects.py.
Four PostgreSQL positive-admission cases exposed inherited receipt-consumption rowcount behavior.

native_history.observation: INSERT rowcount=-1, consume return=false, decision=JOB_INTENT_ALREADY_CONSUMED, persisted consumption=1, application state=READY_TO_SUBMIT
native_history.environment: Native Windows project venv, SQLAlchemy2.1.1, psycopg3.3.6 and disposable PostgreSQL17

native_history.detail: All 22 new SQLite and22 new PostgreSQL cases passed. Two legacy intent fixtures still selected localhost mock URLs for REAL targets; they now use verified synthetic HTTPS employer routes and reject unexpected network calls.
Corrected verified synthetic HTTPS fixtures preserve all replay/intent assertions and forbid unexpected resolver calls.

remaining_gates: All five protected CI checks and source checkout identity
Guarded deployment, exact image/commit, health, disabled gate and backup/rollback verification
Canonical acceptance publication by the single integration owner
limits: The eight-second resolver bound does not establish globally bounded database lock acquisition or the inherited authority-evidence join; MJ-REQ-004 remains PARTIAL.
A completed unresolved attempt preserves the selected route and does not establish that a direct employer route exists.
This does not enable live-provider adapters, grant employer-submission consent or claim a successful employer submission.
